items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had Al Grey, Snooky Young, and myself. Billy Mitchell, Eddie Jones, Marshall Royal.

ctx.x: But at least for that tour, you were able to….

It was a good band. It was a fantastic band and in fact, we had more Basie men in that band than was in the Frank Foster band. We had Al Grey, Snooky Young, and myself. Billy Mitchell, Eddie Jones, Marshall Royal.

items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: but then when Marshal Royal comes in and Neal Hefti does those arrangements, that's when it really changed, don't you think?

ctx.x: -- but then when Marshal Royal comes in and Neal Hefti does those arrangements, that's when it really changed, don't you think?
Yes, I think so. That was definitely -- that was a definite change in the Basie sound.
